headline: Nijman top seed for Minehead as Littler and Aspinall miss out
standfirst: The draw for Minehead on 27-29 November is out, with the two finalists from last year both absent from the 64-player field.
body: Wessel Nijman is top seed for the Players Championship Finals, with the draw made for the 64-player event at Butlins in Minehead from 27 to 29 November, Dartsnews reports.

Luke Littler won the title last year, beating Nathan Aspinall in the final, but neither man qualified this time. Seeding follows the Players Championship Order of Merit, and Nijman opens against Henry Coates, who is the 64th seed.

Chris Dobey is second seed and Kevin Doets third. Among the other first-round pairings are Michael van Gerwen against Connor Scutt, Luke Humphries against Darryl Pilgrim, Gerwyn Price against Sebastian Bialecki, Ross Smith against Michael Smith and Jonny Clayton against Tom Sykes. Beau Greaves, the eighth seed, faces Christian Kist, and Gary Anderson meets Karel Sedlacek.

The format is fast at the start. The first two rounds are best of 11 legs, the third round and quarter-finals are best of 19, and the semi-finals and final are best of 21. Day one is multi-board, as at the UK Open, with a draw after each round.
Van Gerwen has won the event seven times, between 2013 and 2022. Humphries won in 2023 and 2024, and Littler last year.
The tournament is the last big event before the World Championship, which begins on 11 December.
